summary: Two-state button (aria-pressed) and toggle group with single or multiple selection.
whenToUse: On/off options with an immediate effect on content (bold, favorite).
Choosing a view or time period in a bar (single-selection ToggleGroup).
whenNotToUse: Settings saved in a form: use Switch or Checkbox.

props.name: icon
props.description: Decorative icon. Without text, aria-label is required.

props.name: disallowEmptySelection
props.description: ToggleGroup: prevents deselecting the last item.

inherits: Props of react-aria-components ToggleButton and ToggleButtonGroup.

keyboard.action: Toggles the state of the focused toggle.
ToggleGroup: moves focus between items (single tab stop).

accessibility: Single-selection ToggleGroup: radiogroup with radios; multiple: group of buttons with aria-pressed.
The selected state uses color, border, and (in forced-colors) Highlight: not color alone.
responsive: With many items, prefer short labels or icons with aria-label.
customization: Selected color: action.secondary and border.selected tokens. Selectors [data-selected], [data-icon-only].
commonMistakes: Changing the label based on state: aria-pressed already conveys the state.

examples.name: TextGroup
examples.title: Group with text and a disabled item
